findings.claim: The accepted residual is correctly attributed to the owner and is explicitly not called ĐÃ VÁ THẬT. However, its new positive guarantee is still broader than the specified measurement: it says every tracked-file read through a hooked Python process is within Z. A live Python audit hook does not observe native library reads within that same process. Separately, the actual test is oracle({x}) == day_du, which accepts prefix/root paths outside literal Z. This is a scope-description defect in the accepted guarantee, not a demand to reinstate per-child association or reject the accepted aggregate limitation.
findings.hostile_input: In one hooked Python process, first read the normal in-zone witness using pathlib; then call libc.open/read through ctypes to read tracked docs/PROTOCOL_DA_PHIEN.md. No children are spawned, the witness is observed, and the native read is invisible to the open hook. As a separate non-hostile control, read ops/cai_cong_cu.sh normally: the frozen oracle accepts it although it is not a member of Z.

evidence.observed_output: Frozen oracle accepts ops/cai_ and ops/cong_cu prefixes and non-GOC root files; Acceptance 4 checks oracle({x}) == day_du, while new r13 guarantee says all reads through hooked Python processes are in Z.

suggested_fix.where_and_why: Nghiệm thu 4 positive-guarantee sentence and its residual-scope text, with consistent references in section 3. The owner decision is valid for this review; the measurement description must match what is observable.
suggested_fix.how: Describe the guarantee as applying to tracked paths actually recorded by the open audit hook (lexical or realpath identity), each satisfying oracle({x}) == day_du, plus the aggregate child/start count. Explicitly include native/in-process reads that emit no open audit event in the unmeasured residual. Preserve the owner acceptance, successor OS-level measurement and no-wait decision; no reinstatement of the rejected per-parent rule is requested.
suggested_fix.locking_test_and_mutant: Use the two recorded controls when reviewing the wording: the hooked-process native read must remain outside the claimed observation guarantee; the ordinary ops/cai_cong_cu.sh read must satisfy the guarantee via the frozen oracle. Replacing observed open events with all reads or replacing the oracle with membership in Z must be detected as a claim mismatch. A documentation closure need not implement OS tracing in PR2.
suggested_fix.regression_risk: Do not enlarge or shrink Z, change selector behavior, restore the rejected per-parent rule, or label the accepted residual repaired. Calling the property full-zone coverage would reopen the same overclaim.
